title: Trying and buying Ludwig drums, pawning sets, and a new bass drum burned
summary: A music store lent him sets of Ludwig drums to try; he lost several sets to pawn and tells how a brand-new bass drum caught fire by the fireplace.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: You mentioned when the con place opened up on Barone Street.

On Barone Street. What kind did they sell? They sold Ludwig drums. Ludwig. Now, I was... I got in with them somewhere and another. I was well known with them. And, uh... They began to lend me drums. You see, like if I go... I tell them I want to buy a set of drums. But use this set today to see how it'll work out.

And let me go off with that set. I'd bring it back. I'd try out another set like that. Oh, it was very nice for that. And... And... Yeah. I must've tried out about three or four different sets around there. Yes, indeed. And I bought a set off of them thereafter. Finally bought a set. I think I lost about... About three or four sets of drums. I got in tough luck and I pawned them by Goebel Brothers on the record. Oh, yeah. And I lost them. I got out of work, you know. And, uh... I lost my drums. About three or four sets.

I bought a bass drum. I brought it home. It had a big fireplace, something like this. Mm-hmm. And, uh... I hadn't used it. Just bought it. From CG Conn. Bring it home. No, Warline I bought that in front. Set it in front of the fireplace. They had some dust in there somewhere or not. Might have swept dust in there, you know. And... I come in, I lit the... They had lamps. We had lamps. It didn't have no electric.

Load the... Uh, lit that, uh, electric lamp. And show them to match it at dust. And... You puffed up. Well, no. I went on out. Closed the door. When I come back, I notice a lot of smoke in there. Yeah. So, I opened the door right away, you know. And when I got in, the drum was on fire. It didn't burn. I just had bought it. Yeah, you got it. And put it in front of it. And, uh... I didn't... They claim I didn't have any shoot at the house because I just had bought it. Uh, it wasn't an shoot yet, so I had to pay for it.
Didn't use it once. Not even practice all the time.
Yes. Well, uh... I guess that skin would go quick, but it's funny the shell would burn that fast.
